pr.title: Feature flag: rolling-updates

raw_findings.body: The CR adds the build-time feature through the server configuration, but the Operator starts the pre-built server in optimized mode; the persisted build configuration does not contain the feature, so the Keycloak pods fail to start instead of enabling the requested update strategy.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Following the documented configuration with the default image produces an optimized-build configuration mismatch and prevents the managed server from starting.
raw_findings.impact: The CR adds the build-time feature through the server configuration, but the Operator starts the pre-built server in optimized mode; the persisted build configuration does not contain the feature, so the Keycloak pods fail to start instead of enabling the requested update strategy.
raw_findings.root_cause: The new CR example presents runtime feature configuration as sufficient while omitting the corresponding build-time image requirement.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: State next to this example that rolling-updates must also be enabled during `kc.sh build` in a custom image, and show or link to a custom-image build command containing `--features=rolling-updates` before instructing users to set `spec.features.enabled`.
raw_findings.title: Document the required custom image build for rolling-updates
raw_findings.trigger: A user applies the documented Keycloak CR to an Operator deployment using the standard pre-built Keycloak image, rather than an image rebuilt with the rolling-updates feature.

finding.title: Document the required custom image build for rolling-updates
finding.trigger: A user applies the documented Keycloak CR to an Operator deployment using the standard pre-built Keycloak image, rather than an image rebuilt with the rolling-updates feature.
finding.verifier_reason: The claim that the documented CR configuration will cause pods to fail is unsubstantiated. The repository context shows that the Operator's KeycloakDistConfigurator (lines 121-125) maps spec.features.enabled to the --features runtime option, which enables features at runtime. The ROLLING_UPDATES feature is Type.PREVIEW (Profile.java:136), meaning it can be enabled at runtime without requiring a custom build. The operator test (UpgradeTest.java) also enables rolling-updates via spec.featureSpec without requiring a custom image. The candidate's assertion that rolling-updates 'must also be enabled during kc.sh build' is not proven by the available evidence - preview features can be enabled at runtime.
